title: A Refinement of the Spanning Surface Defect in $3$ and $4$ Dimensions
summary: The spanning surface defect uses spanning surfaces of a knot in the $3$-sphere to measure how far a knot is from being alternating. We refine the spanning surface defect and extend the definition to take into account surfaces in the $4$-ball. We use these extensions to make comparisons between the $3$- and $4$-dimensional settings, to reframe non-orientable slice-torus bounds on the non-orientable $4$-genus, and to prove a connected sum formula.
